title: THE ARCHITECT
author: J'son
desc:
This is the catalyst! It is designed for you to fall in love with the gym.

All while providing you with what you need to transform your body!

NOT overly demanding. 
A way to make amazing progress without changing your entire life.
Something anyone can dedicate themselves to.


This was me after 1.5 years of running this simple system. I fell in love with the gym because it was so easy to dedicate myself to only 3 days a week.

You may perform Dip machine or Chest Press Machine Of your choosing. The point is to accumulate volume for Triceps & Chest.
IMO the Dip is superior but requires skill. and is worth the investment
This exercise is a favorite of bodybuilders of the golden Era like Arnold, Mike mentzer and Franco Columbu. Itll grow those Lats and Might even expand the rib cage.
BRO out on this one. I suggest a Preacher Curl for the added support. But if you prefer any other curl DO THAT ONE! Honorable mention is the Bayesian curl.
You can utilize ANY variation of this exercise. In my personal opinion it is helpful to change up the exercise variation after your bored, stalled or it doesent "feel" good for your anthropometry.
U may Supplement with any SQUAT PAttern. This includes leg press, Hack squat, or any machine squat (dont over think it)
This exercise will really blow up those shoulders and the added volume to the triceps will help with getting strong on pressing movements like the bench press.

Use a Myo-Rep

Select a weight you can perform for 8-12 times.

Perform your max reps.

Then match your following sets to the amount of reps you got in the first set.

Utilize Myo reps here. Perform your first set to failure. and then match the reps you got in the 2nd and 3rd set.You might have to take short rest breaks in the middle of the set to reach the goalreps
you can perform any horizontal back movement you enjoy. It is important that you enjoy this exercise because it will be the one you gain the most strength on.
Remember you are dropping the weight by 10 % so on the next set you can get more reps
